Commentary.Commentary: 161 to win for England. A look at their faces and it tells us that they believe that they can get this. But can they? The pitch has plenty of bounce and it may not be an easy run chase. But should be an exciting one. Stay tuned...

It was Tom Curran's day. He was at his best at the death, grabbing his maiden 4-fer in T20Is. But the pick of the bowlers was Adil Rashid, with a frugal 4-0-15-1. Curiously, Chris Jordan did not bowl his full quota of 4 overs, in spite of going for only 16 in his 3 overs and taking 2 scalps, which included a sensational caught and bowled of Bravo.

Special mention for Nicholas Pooran. A well-compiled knock of 58 from 37 balls, combining caution with aggression. He got good support from Bravo but nothing from the rest. Nice to see such maturity on young shoulders.

After being put in to bat, there were no fireworks from the Windies top order. Gayle, Hope and Hetmyer were dismissed in the Powerplay but then Bravo and Pooran stitched together a stand of 64. At that stage, it looked like 170 was on the cards. But Bravo's wicket turned the tide again with the home side losing its way before Pooran dragged the total past 150.
A competitive total posted by the Windies. The last 5 overs have yielded 58. At one stage, they did not even look like crossing 150. We are in for a contest.

OUT! Wicket of the last ball. Low full toss in line of the stumps, Jason swings but not with no real power. The ball goes towards long off where Billings takes an easy catch. Windies end with 160/8 after 20 overs.
BYES! Slower fuller ball outside off, Nurse swings but cannot make contact. They run of the byes. The keeper misses of at the striker's end and Curran misses at the other end. They complete the run.
FOUR! Innovation from Nurse. Curran bowls a faster one on the leg side. Nurse gets into position and paddles it fine to the fine leg boundary. 2 balls left, 11 from the over.
Fuller ball on off, Nurse swings. It goes off the inner half to deep square leg for a brace.
Short ball outside off, Holder swings but doesn't get it off the sweet spot. Falls to cow corner where they take one.
FOUR! Unfortunate. Nothing the bowler can do about it. An inch perfect yorker on the leg stump. The ball squeezes of the inside edge and runs away to the fine leg boundary.
Full and around middle, AN has a wild heave and the ball goes of the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg. A single taken. Brilliant from Rashid - 4-0-15-1!
Slower ball, outside off, fuller in length, pushed towards cover for one.
Tossed up, outside off, another heave-ho missed.

MISFIELD, FOUR! That is unfortunate for Tom Curran. Short and outside off, Nurse punches this through the covers. Curran runs to his right from the deep, gets to the ball but while bending to pick the ball up, his spikes get stuck in the ground! The ball goes through.
WIDE. Too wide outside off, Ashley cannot connect with his mighty slog.
Outside off, slogged towards wide long on for a run.
Short and outside off, Nurse backs away and heaves. Only gets a top edge which does not even carry to mid off. No fielder there anyways. A single taken.
Adil Rashid to bowl out in the 19th. 3-0-6-1 so far.
Slower ball at 109 kph on the stumps, Nurse flicks it towards square leg and takes just one.
WIDE! Bouncer which is above head height. Another extra given.
Ashley Nurse walks in to bat at number 9, replacing Pooran.

OUT! Cleans him up! You miss, I hit stuff from Curran who gets his third of the evening. Length ball on middle, Pooran swings but cannot get behind it. The ball makes a mess of the timber. A good innings from the southpaw comes to an end.
In the air.. safe. Pooran gets low to slog it but the ball gets a top edge but falls safely towards mid-wicket. They come back for the second.
Back of a length ball outside off, Pooran goes for the pull but connects with thin air.

SIX! New ball please! Oh, boy! A 111 meter maximum. In the slot for Pooran who slogs this over mid-wicket for a huge, huge hit. The ball has been lost and the umpires call for a new one. This is Pooran's highest T20I sore now.
Great comeback. Yorker on the stump, Pooran does well to get bat to it.
Wide. Way wide outside off, easy decision for the umpire.
Tom Curran to bowl the 18th over. 2-0-14-2 so far.
Full and on middle, pushed through mid on for a run. 15 runs from the over but the wicket of Allen as well.
The next man in is Jason Holder.

OUT! Caught next ball. Cannot really blame the youngster as we are approaching the final stages of this innings. Full and outside off, Allen gives himself room to the leg side and looks to clear long off but only finds Chris Jordan with ease.

SIX! Just over! Fabulous effort from Sam Billings. Full and outside off, Allen reaches out and plays the slog sweep. He does not get as high an elevation as he desired but just manages to clear a leaping Billings at the mid-wicket fence, who leaps and tries to parry the ball in airborne but in vain.
Pushes this towards long on for a run.
SIX! SLAM! That is an outrageous shot. Simply brilliant. Full and outside leg, Pooran gets into position early, changes grip and plays the switch hit, well over cover!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Big gamble. Joe Denly to bowl the 17th over. 2-0-13-0 so far.
Two is the call again and Windies get it sans no fuss. Around off, tapped past point and takes two.
Back of a length at 131kph. Hurries onto Allen who drags this to deep backward square leg to rotate strike.
Bounce again on the off side, Pooran angles it towards third man for a run.
Wide! Slow ball down the leg. Another wide from the Englishmen.
Great running. Wanted the second as soon as he hit it and makes it easily. Length ball on middle and leg, Pooran gets it from the inside half towards long on. Shouts 'two' and makes it.
Bouncer outside off, Pooran tries hooking it but fails.
FOUR! Pooran continues on his merry way. Fuller ball on the off side, Pooran gets low and lofts this over mid off. No one in the deep and the ball gets past the ropes.
Liam Plunkett to bowl out.
Full and outside off, played straight to point. Spectacular over from Rashid - just a run and a wicket from it. Rashid's figures read 3-0-6-1!
Outside off, short in length, punched straight to point.
Fabian Allen enters the arena now, at number 7, replacing Brathwaite.

OUT! Sharp catch from Jonny Bairstow! The persistence of Rashid pays off. He has been extremely frugal and eventually, has been rewarded. The googly, outside off, Brathwaite goes back to cut but is too close to the ball. Perhaps he did not pick that at all. Hence gets an outside edge but Bairstow behind takes a wonderful catch. Not even a fumble, in spite of standing so close. Another innings not worth remembering for the big man...
Full and outside off, Brathwaite has a wild swing but misses.
Outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around middle, Pooran unfurls the reverse sweep and gets it behind point for a single.
Adil Rashid returns. 2-0-5-0 so far.
Brilliant over from Jordan. A wicket and 7 from it. Ends with 4 dots. Fuller ball on off, Brathwaite cannot get it past covers.
On off, Brathwaite looks to cut it but gets another bottom edge.
Length ball outside off, Carlos fails to put bat to ball.
Carlos Brathwaite is the new man in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! You have seen him taking blinders at the boundary, this one is off his own bowling. Great catch. Slower ball on the off side, Bravo looks to nudge it to the on side but gets a leading edge which comes back to the bowler. Jordon runs to his right, dives, sticks his right hand out and takes an one-handed stunner. Throws the ball in the air and celebrates. The 64-run stand is broken.
WIDE! Down leg again at 141kph. Wide given by the umpire.
Slower ball at 115kph on the stumps, Pooran pushes it past mid off to get the Windies total to 100.
Wide. Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! Wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Just short of the ropes. Overpitched on off, Pooran clears his front leg and lofts this over mid off. No long off and the ball bounces just ahead of the boundary. Good start to the over.
Chris Jordon is back.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Full and around middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run. The crowd is not happy and is jeering. It wanted the second run to be taken.

Huge shout for LBW! Turned down! Well, no review taken. This looked very, very close. Denly tossed this up on middle and Bravo, looking to flick missed and was hit right in front of the stumps. Denly appealed but the umpire turned it down. Now, the bowler asked the keeper something and it would be interesting to see what Bairstow replied. Looked to be plumb in the first replay.
Around leg stump, Bravo misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. A mild LBW appeal ensues but nothing in it.
Outside off, chopped straight to backward point.
WIDE. Tossed up, but outside leg. Bravo misses his flick.
Down the leg side, nicely paddled to short fine leg for a single.
SIX. HUGE! Off she goes. Gets behind this short ball and pulls this high over the mid-wicket boundary. Second maximum off the over. 14 runs from the over. A good one for the hosts.
Bounce! Good ball from Liam. Back of a length again on middle, shoots up suddenly which catches Bravo by surprise. The ball falls in front of him.
No timing. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Pooran goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge which goes towards square leg. They manage to take one.
Bowls it slower on the stumps, Pooran looks to push it past mid off for one but cannot.
SIX! Clobbered away! Short ball on the off, Pooran comes down and slaps it over long on for half a dozen.
Back of a length ball down the leg side, Bravo helps it to fine leg to get to the other end.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler. Good finish from Denly after going for six on the third ball.
Full and around middle, flicked towards deep mid-wicket, calls for two but settles for one.
Down the leg side, swept powerfully towards deep backward square leg for a run.
SIX! PUMMELLED! That is enormous. Flighted outside off, Pooran gets underneath that one and sends it sailing over long off!
Fuller around middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
Joe Denly into the attack.

Great fielding. Billings is the man in the deep. Short ball pulled away towards deep square leg. Billings runs to his left and pulls it inside just near the ropes. Denly throws it back in and keeps it to two. 14 from the over!
On the pads, turned away through square leg for one. 12 runs from the over, one ball left.
Outside off, Bravo cannot get it past point.

SIX! Finally one off the screws. The previous overs were tight with runs not coming at ease, this six should release some pressure. Fuller ball on off, Bravo smokes this over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Around the stumps, Bravo defends this from within the crease.
Wide! This one keeps low. Down the leg side, wide given by the umpire.
FOUR! Off the bat. Short ball on the body. Bravo looks to get away from it but the ball hits his bat and goes over the keeper to the fine leg boundary.
A googly to finish. Pitched outside leg, Nicholas lunges to defend but the ball pitches and whizzes past the outside edge.
Full on middle, Bravo gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and around off, cut straight to backward point.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single.

Beautiful bowling. Tossed up, outside off, Pooran lunges to defend but is beaten by the away turn. Bairstow collects and whips off the bails, appeals but the square leg umpire is unmoved. Replays show that the foot never left the crease.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Wanted two but will have to settle for one. Outside off, Pooran guides it towards third man. Wanted the second but the ball was hit hard to the man stationed there.
On the legs of Bravo who plays it wide of the bowler. Plunkett runs towards the ball but cannot prevent the single.
On the leg side again, Pooran taps it towards square leg and takes a quick run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On the pads, Pooran tucks it around for nothing.
Around off, Bravo taps it past the point region for a single.
WIDE! Back of a length ball down the leg side. Bravo covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Liam Plunkett to bowl now.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, Bravo looks to cut but misses.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Down the leg side, Bravo misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Adil Rashid into the attack.
FOUR! Fine end to the over and Powerplay. A short ball, around middle, Pooran rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary! 43/3 in the Powerplay.
Played straight to point.
Tucked through fine leg for a single.
A short ball, around off, solidly kept out.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and outside off, squeezed through point for a single.
Nicholas Pooran walks in at number 5, replacing Hetmyer.

OUT! Caught! It is not a no ball and Hetmyer is out of here. A dipping full toss, Hetmyer backs away and looks to go over the leg side but only miscues it as long as mid on. Simple catch for Liam Plunkett. They check for the no ball but replays find that the height is fine.
Caught? Or no? No ball for height? Hetmyer has been caught but the umpires are checking for a waist-high no ball...
Outside off, a swing and a miss.
FOUR! Off the top edge. A short ball, Hetmyer swings hard and gets a top edge over the keeper to the fine leg fence.
A short ball, Bravo looks to pull but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Backs away and steers this through the covers for a single.
Darren Bravo walks in at number 4, replacing Gayle.

OUT! Straight to the man! Would you believe it? Gayle is gone! Wow. A nothing delivery. Full and outside off, pretty wide. Chris backs away and looks to slice it away but he actually takes it on the full, hitting it straight to Adil Rashid at short third man! Bonus wicket for England. Gayle does not give any reaction while England have plenty to express.
A length ball now, around middle, Shimron plays an ugly hoick towards mid off and crosses over. The fielder misfields and Shimron wants the second but Gayle is not the least bit interested.
Excellent delivery. A slower ball yorker, around off, Hetmyer swings hard but gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
A bouncer, on middle, Gayle ducks.
Full and around middle, Hetmyer slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Jordan into the attack now.
SIX! No placement, pure power! A length ball, on middle, Gayle just whips it over mid-wicket and the ball travels. 15 from the over, the Windies are up and running.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Excellent comeback, fires in a yorker on middle, Chris just about jams it out towards the leg side for a single.

SIX! Superb shot. A short ball, outside off, Gayle gives himself room to the leg side and slashes it over short third man. The ball goes all the way! This is now the 104th SIX for Gayle in T20Is, the MOST BY ANY!
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Whoa! That is some audacious shot. Walks down the track and swings hard but misses.
WIDE. Full and wide outside off, a slash and a miss from Gayle.
SIX! First of many. Overpitched on the stumps, Hetmyer gets under it and lofts this handsomely over the long on area for a biggie. 8 runs and a wicket from this.
Length ball on off, Hetmyer gets a leading which goes to the point fielder.
On the pads again, Hetmyer misses his flick and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Shimron Hetmyer is in at number 3.

OUT! This time Hope holes out and England hold on to the catch. Hope doesn't make full use of his life and Adil Rashid will be breathing a sign of relief. Length ball on the pads, Hope looks to flick this away. Gets a top edge to it which flies towards mid-wicket. Curran gets under it and makes no mistake. Early wicket for the visitors.
Gayle is off the mark. Not with a boundary but with a single. Taps this with soft hands to the on side and gets to the other end.
Around off, Hope runs it down to the third man region.
Tom Curran to bowl from the other end.
Length this time outside off, Gayle leaves the third ball in a row. Getting his eye in, is the Universal Boss.
Fuller this time outside off, Gayle doesn't go after it.
Length ball outside off, Gayle shoulders his arms to it.

DROPPED! Oh boy, Adil Rashid has dropped a catch. Fuller length outside off again. Hope goes after it and the ball flies to the third man region. Rashid who looked settled under it failed to hold on. The batsmen cross.
Swing and a miss. Fuller ball outside off angling away. Hope goes after it but connects with thin air.
FOUR! What a start for the Windies. Not the best off balls to begin with. Down the leg side on the pads. All Hope does was flicked it away to the fine leg boundary.

The players are out in the baking sun. The visitors walk out in their red kit. Chris Gayle and Shai Hope will open for the Men in Maroon. Davis Willey will bowl the first over of the game. A slip in place for Hope.
Jason Holder the Windies captain says that he is not too sad batting bat first. Says the pitch will remain the same. On his captaincy, he says that it is a new for him in this format.
Eoin Morgan the England skipper says he will bowl first and hopes they restrict the Windies to a total that they can chase.
Team news - Sam Billings, Joe Denly and David Willey come in for the tourists. For the hosts, Fabien Allen and Nicholas Pooran make the playing XI.
TOSS - Morgan wins the coin toss and opts to chase.

If you thought England would steamroll the Windies in the Test series, you got your answer. If you thought the number one ranked side would outplay the number nine ranked side, you were wrong. Now the Windies enter their most favored and preferred format. The T20Is. What a chance for the hosts to end this long, long tour on a high. If the Three Lions thought this series was a waste, they got their reality check. Many players missing for the shortest format of this series and it will be interesting to see how they go about their game. They play in the same venue where the last ODI was played. It's bright and sunny in St. Lucia as the toss and team news awaits us.
